 Live Football Broadcast Schedule Today, November 2, 2026: Juventus vs Napoli, Al Nassr, and Premier League
 Check out the live football broadcast schedule for today, November 2, 2026, featuring matches from Juventus vs Napoli to Al Nassr and the Premier League.
 By: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Editor: Nayla Savitri 
 | 
 Contributor: Keisya Anjani 
 November 2, 2026, 02:15 WITA · 6 min read 
 Image caption: Illustration of today's live football broadcast schedule, Monday (11/2/2026), featuring a number of interesting matches, from Juventus vs Napoli, Athletic Bilbao vs Real Sociedad, Pakhtakor vs Al Nassr, to Newcastle United vs Everton. (Illustration/Aktualita.co) 
 JAKARTA, Aktualita.co -   The live football broadcast schedule for today , Monday (11/2/2026), presents a number of interesting matches from competitions in Europe, the United States, and Asia. The duel between Juventus and Napoli is one of the most anticipated matches, followed by the Athletic Bilbao vs Real Sociedad derby, an Inter Miami match, and Al Nassr's appearance in the AFC Champions League Elite. 
 Indonesian football fans can watch the matches through a number of platforms, including Vidio, beIN Sports, Apple TV, and Vision+, in accordance with the broadcasting rights for each competition. 
 Advertisement 
 The matches take place from early morning until night Western Indonesian Time (WIB). In fact, the series of matches continues until early Tuesday (11/3/2026), including Newcastle United vs Everton in the Premier League and two Italian Serie A matches. 
 For viewers who do not want to miss their favorite matches, here is the complete live football broadcast schedule along with kick-off times and information on the broadcasting platforms. 
 Live Football Broadcast Schedule Today, Monday, November 2, 2026 
 All times in the following list are in Western Indonesian Time (WIB). 
 WIB Time Match Broadcast 
 00:00 Lecce vs Genoa Vidio 
 00:30 Elche vs Valencia beIN Sports 2 
 02:45 Juventus vs Napoli Vidio 
 02:45 Marseille vs Toulouse Vidio 
 03:00 Athletic Bilbao vs Real Sociedad beIN Sports 2 
 07:00 New England Revolution vs Inter Miami Apple TV 
 20:45 Pakhtakor vs Al Nassr Vision+ 
 23:00 Al Sadd vs Al Ahli Vision+* 
 23:00 Al Wasl vs Al Quwa Al Jawiya Vision+* 
 23:00 Tractor Sazi vs Neftchi Vision+* 
 Note: Broadcast information for the three matches at 23:00 WIB refers to the Vision+ broadcast guide. Channel availability may vary and should be checked again through the relevant platform. 
 Juventus vs Napoli, A Big Italian League Duel 
 The match between Juventus and Napoli is one of the main highlights of today's football schedule. Both teams are scheduled to meet at Allianz Stadium, Turin, on Monday (11/2/2026) at 02:45 WIB. 
 The 10th week match of the 2026/2027 Serie A season brings together two clubs that have a long history in Italian football rivalry. 
 Juventus is trying to maximize the advantage of playing at home, while Napoli arrives with the ambition of getting a positive result against one of their tough opponents. 
 Based on official Juventus records ahead of the match, the two clubs have met 160 times in Serie A. Juventus has 72 wins, Napoli 39 wins, while the other 49 matches ended in a draw. 
 These statistics show Juventus' historical advantage. However, the results of previous meetings cannot be used as a guarantee for the outcome of this match. 
 The Juventus vs Napoli match can be watched via the Vidio streaming service for the Indonesian region. 
 Athletic Bilbao vs Real Sociedad, Basque Derby in La Liga 
 From the Spanish League, Athletic Bilbao is scheduled to face Real Sociedad at San Mames Stadium on Monday at 03:00 WIB. 
 This match is significant because it brings together two clubs that both come from the Basque region of Spain. 
 In addition to the battle for points in the La Liga standings, the match also carries a regional rivalry that has been going on for decades. 
 Athletic Bilbao coach, Edin Terzić, emphasized the importance of winning ahead of the match. 
 "We have to win this derby," said Terzić in a press conference before the match, as quoted from the official Athletic Club website. 
 He also asked the players to be able to control their emotions and remain focused on facing an opponent that is considered to be showing positive performance. 
 For Indonesian viewers, the Athletic Bilbao vs Real Sociedad match is listed in the beIN Sports 2 broadcast schedule. 
 Inter Miami Plays Again, Faces New England Revolution 
 United States football fans can also watch the New England Revolution face Inter Miami on Monday (11/2/2026) at 07:00 WIB. 
 The Major League Soccer (MLS) match takes place at Gillette Stadium, Foxborough, Massachusetts. 
 According to official Inter Miami information, the visiting team enters the match after a 2-2 draw against FC Cincinnati. Luis Suárez and Riquelme Fillipi were the goalscorers in the previous match. 
 Inter Miami is certainly trying to get a better result when facing the New England Revolution. 
 This match also attracts the attention of international viewers due to Inter Miami's popularity in recent seasons. 
 The live broadcast of New England Revolution vs Inter Miami is available via Apple TV according to official club information. 
 Pakhtakor vs Al Nassr, AFC Champions League Elite 
 Turning to Asian competitions, Al Nassr is scheduled to face Pakhtakor Tashkent on Monday night in the 2026/2027 AFC Champions League Elite. 
 The match is scheduled to take place at 20:45 WIB or 21:45 WITA at Pakhtakor Markaziy Stadium, Tashkent, Uzbekistan. 
 Al Nassr faces the challenge of playing at the home of the Uzbekistan representative who is trying to utilize the support of their own fans. 
 This match is part of the league phase competition of the AFC Champions League Elite. Every match result affects the club's position in the race for a ticket to the next round. 
 Indonesian viewers can check the broadcast of the match through Vision+, which is listed in the Asian competition broadcast guide. 
 In addition to the Pakhtakor vs Al Nassr match, the same competition also presents Al Sadd vs Al Ahli, Al Wasl vs Al Quwa Al Jawiya, and Tractor Sazi vs Neftchi at 23:00 WIB. 
 Football Schedule Tuesday, November 3, 2026 Early Morning 
 The series of matches on Monday night continues until early Tuesday morning. A number of matches from the Premier League, Italian League, Spanish League, and AFC Champions League Elite are on the next match list. 
 WIB Time Match Broadcast 
 00:30 Sassuolo vs Fiorentina Vidio 
 01:15 Al Ittihad vs Al Ain Vision+ 
 01:15 Al Gharafa vs Al Qadsiah Vision+ 
 02:45 Atalanta vs Parma Vidio 
 03:00 Newcastle United vs Everton Vidio 
 03:00 Deportivo La Coruna vs Osasuna beIN Sports 1 
 The match between Newcastle United and Everton is one of the important Premier League agendas. The duel is scheduled to take place at St. James' Park on Tuesday at 03:00 WIB. 
 Meanwhile, Serie A presents Sassuolo vs Fiorentina and Atalanta vs Parma. Both matches can be watched via Vidio based on the platform's official schedule. 
 How to Watch Today's Live Football Broadcast 
 Viewers can choose a service based on the match they want to watch. 
 Vidio provides certain Premier League, Italian League, and French League matches. beIN Sports broadcasts a number of Spanish League matches, while Vision+ is one of the options for AFC Champions League Elite matches. 
 The Inter Miami match in MLS can be accessed via Apple TV. 
 Some services require a paid subscription. Viewers are advised to check active packages, channel lists, and match availability before making a purchase. 
 Please note that match schedules and broadcasts may change due to decisions by organizers, time adjustments, or policies of the broadcast rights holders. 
 With many matches taking place from early morning until night, football lovers have a variety of viewing options on Monday, November 2, 2026, ranging from elite European club competitions to the best inter-club competitions in Asia.
